_comment: Copy this file for a real forward test. Every REPLACE value must be filled before `open`. decision_cutoff must be within 1 hour of the moment you run `open` and before outcome_window.start. Each information-set cutoff must be exactly decision_cutoff minus 30 days / 72 hours / 24 hours. Every fact that is not null must cite KOD-EVIDENCE-v2 ids (from `kod evidence`) published at or before that set's cutoff, none graded D; a null fact is UNKNOWN and cites nothing. `open` needs a timestamp authority to answer and pushes the anchor commit; run `kod receipt fetch` afterwards. Only a case whose exact anchor commit reached GitHub before outcome_window.start counts. This file is never seeded.

outcome_window.start: REPLACE e.g. 2026-10-08T02:00:00Z (must be after decision_cutoff and after the open)
outcome_window.end: REPLACE e.g. 2026-10-15T09:00:00Z (close is refused before this)

story_hypothesis: REPLACE with the mechanism, in one paragraph, as known at the cutoff.

critic.missing_evidence: REPLACE: what is not in the information sets.
critic.invalidation: REPLACE: the pre-committed observation that kills the call.

dated_catalyst_known: REPLACE evidence id printed by `kod evidence`
